steps.name: create-branch
steps.description: Create task/t0104_nsga2_2obj_dsi_pdrate_3seeds worktree and plan step list (15 canonical steps; research-papers and research-internet skipped because this task forks t0102 verbatim and needs no new external literature).

steps.name: check-deps
steps.description: Verify all 6 dependency tasks (t0024, t0080, t0090, t0093, t0099, t0102) are completed and their code/assets are reusable.

steps.name: init-folders
steps.description: Create mandatory task folder structure including assets/predictions and assets/answer subdirs for the 3 predictions + 1 answer asset.

steps.name: research-papers
steps.description: Skipped. This task forks t0102 verbatim with one objective dropped and one bug-fix; no new paper-level literature review is needed beyond what t0102 already covered.

steps.name: research-internet
steps.description: Skipped. No new external information is required; the substrate, NSGA-II driver, and DSI-guard rationale are all internal to the project.

steps.name: research-code
steps.description: Audit t0102 evaluator.py and nsga2_driver.py to identify exact lines to patch for n_obj=2 and the DSI-silence guard; review t0086 anchor utilities used in analysis.

steps.name: planning
steps.description: Produce plan/plan.md with the 11 mandatory sections, REQ-1..REQ-N including REQ on DSI-guard unit test and idle-teardown wiring, and the cost / risk / verification matrix.

steps.name: setup-machines
steps.description: Provision one Vast.ai EPYC 7B13 64-core Norway instance matching t0102 spec ($0.24/hr target); SCP code; verify smoke gate at N_EVAL_SEEDS=4 with DSI-guard active.

steps.name: implementation
steps.description: Run NSGA-II three times (seeds 44, 55, 66) at pop=96, gens=20, N_EVAL_SEEDS=4, n_obj=2 on the 68-d substrate; pull predictions back; build 3 predictions assets.

steps.name: teardown
steps.description: Destroy Vast.ai instance within 5 minutes of last seed completion; record final cost in costs.json and remote_machines_used.json; run verify_machines_destroyed.

steps.name: creative-thinking
steps.description: Out-of-the-box analysis: per-seed DSI-distribution comparison vs t0102 3-obj front; alternative interpretations of joint-pass yield; flag any unexpected anchor-near clusters.

steps.name: results
steps.description: Write results_summary.md, results_detailed.md, metrics.json, costs.json, remote_machines_used.json; embed plots (HV curves, DSI vs PD scatter per seed, anchor distribution) in results/images/.

steps.name: compare-literature
steps.description: Compare 2-objective Pareto front against t0102 3-obj front in the (DSI, PD) plane; against t0099 N=20 baseline; quantify DSI-guard impact on the silenced-cell corner.

steps.name: suggestions
steps.description: Generate follow-up suggestions; check duplicates against t0102 S-0102-* and t0101 S-0101-* backlog.

steps.name: reporting
steps.description: Run all verificators, capture session transcripts, set task.json status=completed and end_time, prepare PR.
